key: # The settings of misc/make_world_map.py for this map. The map is the east of China at the end of the Eastern Han, in the year 196.
# lat_* and lon_*: the largest box of the map in degrees. The map is a Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection with its centre in the middle of the box.
# margin_hexes: the map is the box of the sites plus this margin, inside the box of lat_* and lon_*.
# city_spacing_hexes: the median distance in hexes from a city to the nearest city. The real map of the placeholder pack has 22. The tool sets the size of a hex from this value.
# km_per_hex: the distance between the centres of two hexes. If you give it, the tool does not use city_spacing_hexes.

# max_hexes: the largest map. The terrain mesh needs approximately 1.65 KB of frame memory for each hex. 80000 hexes fit in the 160 MB of each platform. If the map needs more hexes, the tool makes the hexes larger.
# river_max_scalerank: Natural Earth rivers with this scalerank or less become 河 river hexes. 6 keeps the big rivers only.
# cliff_metres: a hex with a mean height above this value becomes 崖 cliff (no unit can enter).
# river_widths: the 河 rivers for ships and their widths in hexes, after the rivers of the placeholder map. "W|W2@LON": the width W2 west of the longitude LON. 0 = a minor river there.

#   The Yangtze is 7 hexes below the gorges, 5 in Ba and a stream above 105 E, so the land route goes round in the west. The Yellow River cuts the north from the south east of 106 E. The Han is 河 from Xiangyang down.
# river_minor_width and river_minor_terrain: the other rivers are 川 streams of 2 hexes. A road crosses a stream at a 渡所 ford.
# river_banks: yes puts 岸 bank hexes along the 河 rivers. river_fords: no keeps the roads off the 河 rivers. Armies cross them by ship from a port.
# river_shallows_every: a 淺瀨 shallows crossing after each 30 hexes of a stream, so armies can wade across away from the roads.
# river_extra: Natural Earth stops the Yangtze at Jiangyin. This line takes it to the sea.
# mountain_metres: a hex with a mean height above this value becomes 荒地 waste.
# cliff_relief_share: this share of the land becomes 崖 cliff where it stands highest above the lowest land within cliff_relief_hexes.
#   Thus the ridges of the Qinling, the Taihang and the Daba close, and the valleys stay open. The placeholder map has 42% cliff on land.
# cliff_relief_min_metres: a hex less than this height above the land near it never becomes cliff.
